name: Get It Back 60s
_read_me: Fill every FILL_FROM_TIMELINE from %LOCALAPPDATA%\McCluster\Productions\get-it-back\timeline.json and the scenes in blend\get-it-back_full.blend. conform_cut.py refuses a scene name it cannot find. Frames are at 30 fps: 'frames' 240 = 8 s. Past violence stays offscreen: aftermath and reactions only. Sick Filet is fictional.

song._note: Pick source_in_s so the hook (with the confirmed lines: send it stat / definitely getting hacked for that / My pole a ghost) lands inside 0:00-0:40. Use the reviewed lyric timings.

shots.note: 0:00-0:08 Matthew in his Executive Suite, smiling, vibing to the song.
